task.title: Sanitize bidi and zero-width format runes in text-mode output
task.description:
Deferred follow-up from PR #26 (WB-01KZBT1DRC6DYAGHWJXN9EQ9MT), which sanitized text-mode output but only for the Cc block.

core.DisplayLine (internal/core/text.go:16-23) maps runes through unicode.IsControl. Go's unicode.IsControl only consults the Latin-1 property table and returns false for every rune above U+00FF, so the entire Cf (format) category passes through unchanged. Verified empirically:

  U+202E IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE)
  U+202A IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (LEFT-TO-RIGHT EMBEDDING)
  U+2066 IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (LEFT-TO-RIGHT ISOLATE)
  U+2069 IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (POP DIRECTIONAL ISOLATE)
  U+200B IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (ZERO WIDTH SPACE)
  U+200D IsControl=false Is(Cf)=true   (ZERO WIDTH JOINER)
  U+001B IsControl=true  Is(Cc)=true   (ESC, already handled)

Impact: this is the same row-spoofing class the original ticket targeted. A task titled with an embedded RLO renders raw through `workbook show`, `workbook list`, and `workbook board`; on a bidi-aware terminal (macOS Terminal, iTerm2, gnome-terminal) the override reverses the visual order of the rest of the row, so a reviewer scanning `workbook list` can be shown a status/title pairing that does not match the stored task. Zero-width runes additionally let two distinct stored titles render identically.

Sinks are the same ones PR #26 already routes through DisplayLine, so the fix is most likely a single change in internal/core/text.go rather than new call sites: internal/cli/output.go:232 (singleLine, feeding writeMutation, writeShow Title/Description/Labels, the change log and word diff), internal/terminalui/render.go:35,38,192,193,261,264 (list rows and both board layouts), internal/core/service.go:712,723 (commit subject and labels).

Tradeoff to decide before implementing, already flagged in the PR #26 body: blanket-stripping Cf would also drop U+200D, which is load-bearing inside emoji ZWJ sequences, so a title containing a family or profession emoji would render as its component glyphs. Options worth weighing: (a) strip only the bidi controls U+202A-U+202E and U+2066-U+2069 and leave the rest of Cf alone; (b) strip all of Cf except U+200D; (c) strip all of Cf and accept the emoji regression. Whichever is chosen, extend internal/core/text_test.go and the sanitize tests in internal/cli/sanitize_test.go and internal/terminalui/render_test.go with a bidi case.

Also in scope: the README section added by PR #26 ("Text-mode output safety", README.md:681-694 on main) asserts the broader property without the Cc-only caveat that the PR description carries -- it says text-mode rendering "treats them as untrusted" and that "an escape sequence in a title cannot redraw the row into a task that does not exist". That is true for escape sequences but overstates the guarantee against visual reordering. Either narrow the README wording now or update it together with the Cf fix.

Deferred from PR #26 because the acceptance criterion on WB-01KZBT1DRC6DYAGHWJXN9EQ9MT names unicode.IsControl explicitly, the gap was disclosed in the PR body, and the ZWJ/emoji tradeoff above deserves its own decision rather than being smuggled into a merge.
